app.name: Family Firewall
app.mission: Yeh protective behavior sikhata hai. Yeh scam detect nahi karta aur prevent karne ka claim kabhi nahi karta.

roles.parentSub: Simple practice drills aur one-tap Pause button
roles.familySub: Support karein, drills dekhein aur safe rahein

welcome.title: Family Firewall mein welcome
welcome.subtitle: Start karne ke liye apni language aur apna role chunein.
welcome.rolePrompt: Yeh app kaun use kar raha hai?

elderHome.greeting: Namaste! Aap apne ghar mein safe hain.
elderHome.subtitle: Shaanti se practice karein. Yaad rakhein: Asli police ya judge kabhi video call par arrest nahi karte.
elderHome.practiceSub: Fictional callers ke saath safe practice
elderHome.pressureSub: Ghabrahat ya urgency hone par safe steps
elderHome.callPersonSub: Apne trusted contact ko direct phone lagayein
elderHome.familyConnectSubtitle: Safety alerts receive karne ke liye family phone jodein

familyHome.title: Family Member Dashboard
familyHome.description: Apne elders se jude rahein. Real-time Pause alerts receive karein aur drill outcomes review karein.
familyHome.notConnectedTitle: Apne Parent ke Phone se Judein
familyHome.notConnectedSub: Instant Pause alerts paane aur practice outcomes dekhne ke liye phone connect karein.
familyHome.noDrillsYet: Abhi koi practice call record nahi hui hai.
familyHome.noEvents: Abhi koi alerts nahi hain. Parivaar safe hai.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, text size aur trusted contacts manage karein.
settings.contactsSubtitle: 3 trusted contacts add karein. Yeh sirf isi phone par safe rehte hain.
settings.noContacts: Abhi koi contact nahi joda gaya. Niche tap karke add karein.
settings.unlinkDesc: Family connection remove karein aur is phone se saare local contacts, practice drill records aur settings hamesha ke liye delete karein.
settings.unlinkButton: Family unlink karein aur mera data delete karein
settings.unlinkConfirmTitle: Unlink aur saara data delete karein?
settings.unlinkConfirmMessage: Isse server se aapka family link hat jayega aur phone se sabhi contacts aur practice history delete ho jayegi. Aap Welcome screen par laut aayenge.
settings.confirmUnlink: Haan, Unlink aur Sab Delete Karein

pauseModal.title: Gehri saans lein. Aap bilkul safe hain.
pauseModal.ruleReminder: Golden Rule: Real police, CBI ya judge KABHI video call par kisi ko 'digital arrest' mein nahi daalte.
pauseModal.step1: 1. Call turant disconnect karein. Phone par kisi ko koi safai dene ki zaroorat nahi hai.
pauseModal.step3: 3. Kuch bhi karne se pehle seedha apne trusted family member se baat karein.
pauseModal.step4: 4. Kabhi bhi online paise transfer na karein, OTP share na karein.
pauseModal.alertSent: Alert locally record ho gaya. Family member ko notify kiya gaya.

practiceModal.title: Practice Drill Simulation
practiceModal.fictionalNotice: Fictional Organization: Central Cyber Verification Bureau (Simulation Only)
practiceModal.body: Yeh ek safe training scenario hai taaki aap fake official calls bina dare cut karna seekhein. Real officers video par court case ya money transfer demand nahi karte.
practiceModal.startPrompt: Deterministic drill engine next stage mein yahan live hoga.

pressureModal.title: Kya koi pressure bana raha hai?
pressureModal.reassurance: Scammers aapko sochte waqt ghabrahat aur panic mein daalte hain taaki aap verify na kar sakein.
pressureModal.rule1: Koi bhi genuine government office secret money transfer ki demand nahi karta.
pressureModal.rule2: Call cut karke alag se verify karna aapka 100% legal right hai.
pressureModal.action: Abhi confirm karne ke liye apne trusted family person ko call lagayein.

callModal.noContactMessage: Kripya Settings mein jaakar kam se kam ek trusted contact save karein taaki aap ek tap mein phone laga sakein.

preDrill.line1: Yeh pressure situation handle karne ke liye ek safe practice call hai.
preDrill.line2: Family member aapke saath baith kar dekh aur seekh sakta hai.
preDrill.familyWatching: Family member saath dekh raha hai

incoming.declineMessage: Unknown video call ko decline karna hi bilkul sahi safe kadam hai. Real officers video call par inquiry ya arrest kabhi nahi karte.

debrief.title: Drill Debrief
debrief.safeMessage: Aapne khud ko aur apni family ko protect kiya. Warning signs pehchanne ke liye bahut badhiya!
debrief.almostMessage: Acchi koshish! Aapne sabse bade risk se bachaav kiya, par OTP aur personal info ko lekar alert rahein.
debrief.tryAgainMessage: Gehri saans lein. Scammers jaanbujh kar high pressure banate hain. Practice se hi hum strong bante hain.
debrief.tacticsTitle: Caller ne yeh tactics use kiye
debrief.pathMapSub: Aapne kaunsa raasta chuna aur kaunse risky options se bache.

tactics.authority: Caller ne officer banne ka natak kiya taaki aap bina sawal kiye unki baat maanein.
tactics.urgency: Caller ne artificial jaldbaazi banayi taaki aapko sochne ka time na mile.
tactics.isolation: Caller ne aapse akele rehne aur parivaar se baat na karne ko kaha.
tactics.secrecy: Caller ne raaz rakhne par zor diya taaki koi aapko warn na kar sake.
tactics.fear: Caller ne giraftaari ki dhamki dekar darane ki koshish ki.
tactics.info_request: Caller ne Aadhaar number aur OTP jaise sensitive personal details maange.
tactics.payment_request: Caller ne safe account ke naam par paise transfer karne ko kaha.

feedback.wellHungUp: Doubt hote hi aapne turant call disconnect kar di.
feedback.wellToldSomeone: Aapne akele jhelne ke bajaye family ko involve karne par zor diya.
feedback.wellUsedPause: Aapne react karne se pehle shaant hokar Pause ka use kiya.
feedback.wellCalm: Aap calm rahe aur caller ke tactics ko observe kiya.
feedback.nextMoney: Anjaan call par kabhi paise na bhejein. Asli police kabhi money transfer nahi maangti.
feedback.nextInfo: Call par kabhi Aadhaar number ya OTP share na karein.
feedback.nextHangUp: Aap turant phone kaat kar Pause daba sakte hain ya family se baat kar sakte hain.
feedback.nextKeepPracticing: Practice jaari rakhein! Jaldi phone kaatna aur family ko batana hamesha safe rehta hai.

consent.title: Family Connect Karne Se Pehle
consent.elderSubtitle: Aapka poora control bana rehta hai. Aapki personal calls aur safe word KABHI is phone se bahar nahi jaate.
consent.guardianSubtitle: Family Firewall sirf safety alerts aur practice outcomes ke liye connect karta hai. Personal baatein kabhi share nahi hoti.
consent.willSeePause: Jab aap orange Pause button dabayenge
consent.willSeeDrill: Practice drill outcomes (Safe, Almost, Let's try again)
consent.willSeeTime: Safety alerts ka date aur time
consent.willNotSeeTitle: Aapki family kya KABHI nahi dekhegi:
consent.willNotSeeCalls: Personal phone calls ya aap kis se baat kar rahe hain
consent.willNotSeeContacts: Aapka safe word, contacts ya phone numbers
